page.title: Grace Hopper
page.desc: 1906–1992. US Navy rear admiral and computer scientist; wrote the A-0 system (1952), one of the first compilers, led FLOW-MATIC, and shaped COBOL's English-like syntax.
page.intro: 1906–1992. US Navy rear admiral and computer scientist; wrote the A-0 system (1952), one of the first compilers, led FLOW-MATIC, and shaped COBOL's English-like syntax.

synapses.text: A-0 translated symbolic code into machine code at a time when many believed computers could only do arithmetic.
Her team taped a moth found in a Harvard Mark II relay into the 1947 logbook as the "first actual case of bug being found"; the word was older, the story made it stick.
